dialogues.en:
<$cdef(27)><$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,10)><$voicel(4,6)>Of course, I should have realized that belongs to you!
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,666)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,7)>If you’ve ever got some to spare, though, I do hope you’ll
share with me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$cdef(27)><$comeff(4,4)><$facial(4,10)><$voicel(4,6)>Claro que devia ter percebido que isso te pertence!
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,666)><$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,7)>Se você já tem algum para poupar, no entanto, eu espero que você vai
partilha comigo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>Thank you so much, <$cdef(27)>, dear!
The inside of the watermelon looks so delicious!
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,644)><$facial(4,2)><$voicel(4,8)>Any chance I could dig in right away? Don’t mind if I do!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)><$voicel(4,9)>Muito obrigado. <$cdef(27)>, querido!
O interior da melancia parece tão delicioso!
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,644)><$facial(4,2)><$voicel(4,8)>Alguma chance que eu poderia cavar dentro imediatamente? Não se importa se eu fizer!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)><$facial(4,4)>Mmm! Oh, that’s positively scrumptious! Even surrounded

foi
